<div class="card-body">
'''Krayt Dragon Howl''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] ([[Lost Interrupt]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">クレイト・ドラゴンの叫び</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">位置カードでの戦闘で、オビ＝ワンが単独で防衛している場合、戦力に＋１し、戦闘運命数を１枚余分に引ける。オビ＝ワンでなく、能力値＞２の反乱軍なら、戦闘運命数を１枚余分に引ける。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-93o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">オビ＝ワン・ケノービはジェダイの技を使い、クレイト・ドラゴンの獰猛な叫びを完璧にまね、タスケン・レイダーをルーク・スカイウォーカーから追い払った。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Krayt Dragon Howl.

'''Card text:''' If Obi-Wan is defending a battle alone at a site, power +1 and draw one extra battle destiny. If a Rebel of ability > 2 other than Obi-Wan is defending a battle alone, draw one extra battle destiny.

'''Lore:''' Using Jedi skill, Obi-Wan Kenobi perfectly imitated the fierce cry of a krayt dragon and drove the Tusken Raiders away from Luke Skywalker.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Krayt Dragon Howl]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
